assets.prompt: Edit the attached original StockWars building asset into a usable RPG TOP-DOWN building sprite. The attachment is the exact appearance/style identity reference and the edit target, NOT a camera reference. Preserve its clean smooth 2D cartoon illustration, dark navy outlines, soft simple shading, original colors, facade motifs, recognizable silhouette and storefront identity. Change camera to an elevated FRONT-facing RPG orthographic view: roof top plane clearly visible occupying roughly the upper third, facade foreshortened vertically beneath it, front wall horizontal across the screen, vertical wall edges upright, depth recedes straight toward screen top. No yaw rotation, no diamond/isometric view, no vanishing point. This camera choice is for these experimental assets only. Render ONE entire building, isolated centered on truly transparent alpha, with 4-6% transparent margin, no clipped edges. No ground tile, no road, no sidewalk, no trees, no lamps, no detached decorative props, no characters, no background glow, no cast shadow outside the building, no text labels. Preserve built-in signs and symbol icons, but add no words. Roof must be a coherent part of the structure, not an added slab standing vertically behind its sign. Clearly visible entrance at bottom of front facade. Do not redesign architecture or switch to painterly, pixel, realistic, or 3D render style. Specific building: Cream and teal narrow seven-story home office apartment tower with peach floor bands, blue windows in three columns, one warm window. Preserve its tall residential identity and floor count. Add a clearly visible flat roof top surface with parapet in the upper portion; show foreshortened facade under it. No detached planters.
